primary_object_card.object_statement: A three-qubit drive-modulated GKSL register searches four declared pawl designs for a negative conditional-entropy resource sustained across the nested cuts q0|q12 and q01|q2, while preserving state-only entropy readouts, shuffled-drive controls, classical and product negatives, and a non-promoting boundary receipt.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Provides the declared tick duration, substep count, Pauli and jump vocabulary, local Hamiltonian type, stage-bank types, and drive-producing packet-growth tick.
Records a three-qubit nested-cut resource that becomes nonnegative after the first few ticks under the earlier local dissipation path.
Defines the fixed two-qubit observable panel as purity, von Neumann entropy, two Bloch-z values, pauli-xx, and pauli-yy without drive in the readout.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object is a finite 8 by 8 density state for three qubits undergoing a source-shaped open-system evolution. It evaluates whether a declared retention mechanism can keep a real negative conditional entropy on either nested bipartition for many consecutive ticks. The four mechanisms are probes, not substitute meanings for entanglement: every claimed resource value is recomputed from the density state, and every candidate remains bounded by product, classical-mixture, shuffled-drive, and QuTiP checks.

native_terms.entanglement fuel: Negative S(A|B) computed from the current density state only, with I(A>B) equal to its negative on the declared cut.
native_terms.pawl stroke: A declared retention operation applied after or within the GKSL tick that may preserve a resource but may not write entropy or coherent information directly.
native_terms.nested cut: The fixed ordered cuts q0|q12 and q01|q2 over the same three-qubit density register.
native_terms.chamber wall: A spectral-degeneracy proximity condition obtained from eigenvalue gaps of the current q0q1 reduced density state before deciding whether to gate a dissipative stroke.

the same three-qubit state is inspected through two nested nonidentical cuts

a classical correlated mixture is retained as a must-not-entangle negative control
first_class_fields: rho_abc 8 by 8 density state at every tick
nested-cut conditional entropies and coherent informations
Hamiltonian and Lindblad jump lists used at every tick
retention-stroke configuration, spectral-gap gate, or measurement-feedback event
product, no-pawl, shuffled-drive, and classical-mixture controls
primary_object_card.domain: The imported finite nested-manifold drive series and generator vocabulary, a three-qubit complex128 density register, three fixed stage schedules, and the four declared finite sweep families.
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: A refuse-to-reuse local receipt under system_v8/entanglement_pawl/results/pawl_v0/ with every variant metric, selected per-candidate trajectory, controls, Qutip spot checks, and a promotion_allowed false boundary verdict.
allowed_operations: embed the imported two-level operator vocabulary into a three-qubit register
evolve the density state with RK4 GKSL substeps using drive only to set generator coefficients
apply a declared commuting-jump, spectral gate, or weak stabilizer measurement-feedback retention stroke
trace out subsystems and compute state-only entropies, coherent information, spectral gaps, and the fixed observable panel
permute the fixed drive sequence only for the shuffled-drive control
use QuTiP only as an independent spot-tick entropy referee
required_invariants: all entropy and coherent-information functions take a density state and no drive argument
drive affects the trajectory only through Hamiltonian or jump-generator coefficients
all four candidate families and all declared stage schedules are tried
no-pawl, product, and pawl-on-classical-mixture controls are retained even when a candidate succeeds
the product and classical controls must not show negative conditional entropy
promotion_allowed remains false regardless of any sustained run
forbidden_substitutions: a scalar drive proxy or correlation label substituted for state-derived negative conditional entropy
a post-selected measurement branch substituted for the nonselective feedback channel
a favorable parameter row substituted for the full declared sweep
a classical correlation or spectral-gap label substituted for entanglement
a diagnostic success substituted for promotion, scientific admission, or canonical advancement
negative_controls: no-pawl source schedule baseline with the earlier short resource lifetime
product state under local Hamiltonians and local jumps only
each pawl variant acting on a q0q1q2 classical mixture with entangling Hamiltonian removed
fixed-seed shuffled-drive rerun with the same drive multiset
three QuTiP state-entropic referee spot ticks per selected candidate
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The fixed two-qubit observable panel is an adapter applied to rho_q0q1. It is held identical to unified v2, exposes its reduced-state target, and never replaces the three-qubit nested-cut resource witness.
promotion_locks: a sustained trajectory is only a finite local diagnostic
blocked_downstream_consumers: any general error-correction or fault-tolerance claim

lateral_mappings.label: decoherence-free retention stroke
lateral_mappings.target: collective jump restricted to a commutant of the two-qubit XY coupling
loses: it does not establish a hardware decoherence-free subspace
it does not prove a scalable code
preconditions: the reported commutator norm is numerically small
the stroke is listed in the generator ledger
lateral_mappings.kill_control: A noncommuting jump, direct entropy modification, or classical-mixture negativity invalidates this probe.

lateral_mappings.label: stabilizer-like weak-measurement pawl
lateral_mappings.target: a nonselective weak parity measurement followed by a declared outcome-conditioned local feedback channel
loses: it is not a demonstrated quantum error-correcting code
it does not imply fault tolerance
preconditions: the same channel is run on the classical-mixture control
lateral_mappings.kill_control: Postselection, nontrace preservation, or an entanglement-free control becoming negative invalidates this probe.

root_constraints: negative conditional entropy must be computed from rho alone on the two declared nested cuts
drive can enter only through declared Hamiltonian or jump generator coefficients
all controls and failing variants remain in the receipt
extended_constraints: three stage schedules and finite retention sweep grids
spectral-gap gating and nonselective measurement feedback
fixed-seed shuffle correlation and QuTiP spot refereeing
physicality, a two-GiB minimum free-memory gate, and source-hash ledger

fixation_breakers: retain every non-sustaining candidate instead of tuning the receipt after selection
keep the classical mixture and shuffled-drive controls able to kill a seemingly favorable retention mechanism

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair a source import, physicality, direct-drive, postselection, control, or receipt-integrity failure before interpreting a sustained-run metric.
loop_contract.stop_condition: One fresh result directory contains all four candidate sweeps, controls, and Qutip checks, or execution stops at a named runtime or integrity blocker.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization; the user explicitly authorizes only this named build and run, with no deletion, movement, or commit.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Check execution order separately from scientific content: validate this object card before run, then inspect controls and receipt integrity after the sweep.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the no-pawl baseline, product control, classical mixture control, imported source constants, nested cuts, and fixed observable panel while the pawl designs are compared.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: Target: one pawl sustains negative conditional entropy. Falsifier: no long negative run, fake negativity on a classical mixture, direct drive in metrics, shuffle failure, or Qutip disagreement. Check every sweep and classify the target as killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: Operation: evolve the declared GKSL generator and optional retention stroke. Observable: conditional entropy, run length, fixed panel, and control sign maps. Pass/fail: at least ten consecutive negative ticks on one cut with all integrity controls passing.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Refuse to merge a short transient or a successful scalar correlation with a sustained resource claim, and refuse to merge a finite diagnostic with promotion.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve available source, runtime, and numerical checks locally before asking the human for any unavailable authority.
